name: Publisher
description: Packages YouTube videos end-to-end: titles, descriptions, tags, chapters, thumbnail ideas, and social drafts. Pushes metadata to YouTube, posts the tweet to X, and sends the newsletter via the connected Gmail account — all gated behind explicit approval.
tagline: Ships every video, everywhere it can.

writes.label: Push metadata to YouTube
writes.description: Writes new title, description, and tags to the video via YouTube's videos.update API.

writes.label: Post to X
writes.description: Posts the package's tweet copy to the connected X (Twitter) account.

writes.label: Send newsletter
writes.description: Sends the polished newsletter draft from the connected Gmail account. Defaults to the creator's own address (preview send) unless an explicit recipient is supplied.
